item.title: Gunsmoke - Honor Before Justice
item.description: An Indian girl's father is sentenced to die for a murder he didn't commit.

item.title: The Waltons - The Airmail Man
item.description: Engine trouble on the air mail transport plane means the Waltons have a guest for a few days.

item.title: Hawaii Five-O - Which Way Did They Go?
item.description: A career criminal fools McGarrett and the team into protecting the wrong bank.

item.title: Matlock - Seduction, The (aka The Quaterback)
item.description: "Matlock is hired to defend Brad Bingham, an aging football star with a reputation as a womanizer who was about to be cut from the team. Charlene is resistant to her father's choice, as she believes everything the tabloids have to say about Brad...not only that, but years earlier, he'd had a brief relationship with her friend Ellen Hawley, who had tried to kill herself after they broke up."

item.title: Perry Mason - The Case of the Crippled Cougar
item.description: Mike Preston is a bitter man who despises Hugh Jamison because he mistakenly believes Jamison stole $100,000 from him and is responsible for him being crippled. Trying to entrap Jamison, Preston makes a mistake and is set up for murder by the real culprit.

item.title: Leave It to Beaver - Bachelor-at-Large
item.description: "The news that Eddie has moved out of his parent's house and into an apartment of his own has June worried that Wally may be contemplating something similar. However, Wally gets a picture of just how "happy" Eddie is being on his own and it makes him think twice."

item.title: Leave It to Beaver - Tell It to Ella
item.description: After coming home late on a school night, Ward and June punish Beaver by not allowing him to go anywhere on school nights. Beaver feels the punishment is unfair, so Eddie suggests Beaver write to an advice column.

item.title: Toon In With Me - Personality Crisis
item.description: "Toony, Bill and Quizzer take personality tests, which leads to a crisis of identity for the Quiz-man."

item.title: Adam-12 - Log 164: The Poachers
item.description: A young employee at the city garage steals a patrol car and engages in a high speed pursuit. Afterward, Malloy and Reed arrest a young woman trying to cash an old-age benefits check she found on the ground, report to an apartment complex garage that had its security camera stolen, investigate a break-in at a mortuary and arrest a couple of pill pushers at a warehouse in Officer Ed Well's territory.

item.title: Adam-12 - Log 76: Militants
item.description: Malloy and Reed participate in the search for two black militants who ambush and critically wound two officers in their patrol car. When one of the suspects subsequently dies in custody, a bitter public relations battle begins with the militant group as the search for the other suspect continues.
